items.title: File Clark County business personal property return
items.description: Washington personal property listings are due to the county assessor by April 30 for equipment held on January 1. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File King County business personal property return
items.description: Washington personal property listings are due to the county assessor by April 30 for equipment held on January 1. Listings can be filed on paper or through eListing; late listings take a 5% monthly penalty up to 25%, and no extensions are granted.
